subject: Academic Communication
provisional_note: Semester 1 (Jul-Dec 2026) follows the official MoEST 2026 calendar. Semester 2 (Jan-May 2027) is inferred from the 2026 pattern and ends before the ACSEE examinations - replace it with the published 2026/2027 almanac before relying on those dates.

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (a) Construct sentences (complex, compound, etc.) by observing subject-verb agreement and appropriate word order in oral and written communications
teaching_learning_activities: TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide individual students through constructing sentences of different types and writing them down for presentation
Dialogue: Guide students through conversations to discuss the sentences used in the dialogue
entries.assessment: Sentences (complex, compound, etc.) are constructed properly by observing subject-verb agreement and appropriate word order
resources: oral and written texts on various fields for sentence construction
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (b) Justify the necessity of word order in sentence construction
teaching_learning_activities: Scenarios: Guide students through justifying the necessity of word order in sentence construction
Debate: Guide students through debating on whether it is necessary or not to have word order in sentences construction
entries.assessment: The necessity of word order in sentence construction is justified
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (c) Use field-specific vocabularies (e.g., science, commerce, agriculture, etc.) in oral and written communication
teaching_learning_activities: Scenarios: Prepare a scenario that will guide students to identify field specific vocabularies and present them to the class
Project work: Assign students to do practical activities in science, commerce, agriculture, etc. and write reports on the performed practicals
entries.assessment: Field-specific vocabulary (e.g., science, commerce, agriculture, etc.) are used appropriately in oral and written communications.
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate understanding of the basic principles and usage of English language (e.g., syntax, pronunciation, grammar, etc.)
entries.learning_activity: (d) Interpret implied meanings of words and sentences in various contexts
teaching_learning_activities: Role-play: Prepare role-plays with words and sentences that will help students to interpret their implied meanings
Dialogue: Guide students through speaking out the words and sentences to interpret implied meanings
entries.assessment: Implied meanings of words and sentences are interpreted correctly in various context
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education

entries.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of principles of English language
entries.specific_competence: 1.2 Apply principles of language to construct sentences, paragraphs and texts
entries.learning_activity: (a) Write various reports using appropriate procedures
teaching_learning_activities: Project work: Guide students through preparing different reports, and let them present the report to the class
Simulation: Ask students to simulate a situation for a meeting and guide them through writing reports from the meetings
Demonstration: Prepare samples of memos and various reports, and guide students through reading and differentiating them
TIPS (Think-Ink-Pair-Share): Guide students through writing various reports and formal letters
entries.assessment: Various reports are written properly
resources: reports and memos for writing various reports
entries.references: TIE, Academic Communication for Advanced Secondary Schools Form Six: Student's Book and Teacher's Guide, Tanzania Institute of Education
